body:
2 seeds smoked 1 eaten datura inoxia
The onset was great I felt a dark feeling of calm within me. This turned into me deciding to get sober from all substances; stop believing in delusions; and stop giving into the BS that everyone tries to give me. I felt like all my religious choices and weird thoughts were just unreasonable and insane. I also decided to stop judging people, because we're all human in this rediculous machine that humans made known as poisonous belief together. This feeling stayed the entire trip. Eventually I had a nice euphoria I would say was relaxing. When the night came I saw this hooded figure that gave off this vibe of protection, some would say it was instilling fear. Eventually that turned into one of my friends with his spine dangling out for a minute and he started to talk to me very gently and calmly. It was like he just had the best day of his life and he wanted to tell me about it. Weird at first but I couldn't help but laugh about it. This stuff is amazing... I've told myself I'm going to use it for microdosing only. Let's see how that goes.
